entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I need to return something. I have my order number if you need it.
I can certainly look into that for you. What is the order number?
It's VF78-990-12B. It's for a jersey I bought a little while ago.
Okay, I have your order pulled up. I see the Apex Performance Jersey. What specifically seems to be the issue with it?
It's just the wrong size. I waited a bit to try it on, and it's much too tight. I'm so disappointed. I've been a loyal customer for so long and I was really looking forward to this.

I'm sorry to hear it didn't fit as you expected. Let me just check the delivery date for you... Okay, I see it was delivered 79 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return policy for standard items.
Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried. I really needed this money back for some other bills. Are you sure it's okay?
Yes, absolutely. We can definitely process this for you. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
A refund would be amazing, thank you so much. You have no idea what a relief this is.

Not a problem at all. I have just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. Just attach that to the package with the jersey inside, and you can drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it.
That's perfect. Wow, thank you, Diana. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
